title: FlowSep-RF: Rectified Flow Matching for Single-Channel Radio-Frequency Signal Separation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20269v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-channel radio-frequency (RF) signal separation is important for interference mitigation when a signal of interest overlaps with a co-channel interferer in time and frequency. Classical matched filtering and LMMSE receivers are limited under structured non-Gaussian interference, while diffusion and score-based methods often require iterative sampling or optimization. We propose FlowSep-RF, a rectified flow matching framework that learns a clean-endpoint transport from the received mixture to the signal of interest. The model combines time-domain IQ samples with frequency-domain features and recovers the separated waveform using one endpoint velocity evaluation. We evaluate FlowSep-RF on QPSK mixtures with OFDM-BPSK, OFDM-QPSK, and RFChallenge CommSignal2 interference against classical, discriminative, and generative baselines. translated_title: FlowSep-RF：用于单信道射频信号分离的整流流匹配
translated_abstract: 单信道射频（RF）信号分离对于干扰抑制至关重要，尤其当目标信号与同信道干扰在时域和频域上发生重叠时。经典的匹配滤波和LMMSE接收机在结构化非高斯干扰下性能受限，而基于扩散和分数的方法通常需要迭代采样或优化。我们提出FlowSep-RF，这是一种整流流匹配框架，它学习从接收到的混合信号到目标信号的干净端点传输。该模型将时域IQ采样与频域特征相结合，仅需一次端点速度评估即可恢复分离出的波形。我们在包含OFDM-BPSK、OFDM-QPSK和RFChallenge CommSignal2干扰的QPSK混合信号上，将FlowSep-RF与经典方法、判别式方法和生成式基线进行了对比评估。在所有三种设置下，FlowSep-RF在所有被评估的基线方法中均取得了最低的平均误码率（BER）和均方误差（MSE）。
tldr: 提出FlowSep-RF整流流匹配框架，通过融合时域IQ采样与频域特征、仅需一次端点速度评估即可完成单信道射频信号分离，在多种干扰场景下取得最低误码率和均方误差。
en_tdlr: FlowSep-RF is a rectified flow matching framework that achieves single-channel RF signal separation by learning a clean-endpoint transport from the mixture to the signal of interest, combining time-domain IQ samples with frequency-domain features and requiring only one endpoint velocity evaluation, attaining the lowest BER and MSE across multiple interference settings.
